commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+2' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.

90' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the roof of the net, but David de Gea reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
88' AS Roma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

75' None of the Fiorentina players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.

72' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Matias Soule will be replaced by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).

66' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from AS Roma for a penalty. Play continues.
64' Substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Manu Kone walks off.

60' Fiorentina hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.

58' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) alters the score to 4:0. He latched on to a good cross into the box from Donyell Malen, steering his header from close range off the post into the bottom left corner. David de Gea was helpless.

57' The Fiorentina players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for AS Roma.

55' Fiorentina slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
54' Dodo (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
53' AS Roma will take a corner kick.
52' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the bar.
51' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

49' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
48' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

47' Riccardo Braschi (Fiorentina) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
47' Fiorentina enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

36' A tremendous drive by Donyell Malen (AS Roma) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but David de Gea makes a brilliant save.
34' 3 - 0 Goal! Manu Kone displays great vision and sends a pass to Mario Hermoso (AS Roma), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 3:0.
33' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Albert Gudmundsson, but Mile Svilar displays great awareness to stop him.
32' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
29' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) sends an accurate short pass. Donyell Malen controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
27' The ratio of the ball possession is 64:36.

23' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) and Niccolo Pisilli matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
21' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.
20' The game is interrupted as Matias Soule (AS Roma) is flagged offside.
19' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
17' 2 - 0 Goal! Mario Hermoso shows great vision to find Wesley Franca (AS Roma) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
16' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

16' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will take a throw-in.

13' 1 - 0 Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Niccolo Pisilli. His bullet header went towards the middle of the goal and behind the goalkeeper. It's 1:0.
13' The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.
12' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the bar. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
10' AS Roma keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
10' AS Roma keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
8' Neat passing move from Fiorentina in order to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
6' Fiorentina control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
5' AS Roma are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball is behind the touchline and AS Roma will take a throw-in.
4' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

3' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out for a corner. Fiorentina can continue in their attacking effort.
3' The Fiorentina players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
